svg.title: Overturn — fleet architecture
svg.desc: Seven agents behind a per-agent access gateway. A denial letter enters through Cloud Storage and Pub/Sub into Cloud Run. Six agents run in sequence; Drafting and Verification form a retry loop capped at three attempts. A two-signature human gate stops everything until a billing clerk and a clinician both sign the same draft attempt. Every external effect passes an idempotency guard. After submission no process runs; state lives only in the Firestore cases collection until Cloud Scheduler wakes a Cloud Run job that runs the Lifecycle agent.
svg.text: Seven agents · one service account each · least privilege enforced in code · durable across weeks
Firestore has no collection-level IAM. These grants are enforced
in code by core/gateway.py POLICY. There is no second door.
Vertex AI · us-central1 — model per agent ▾

g.text: Agents compute. This persists, transitions, and performs every external effect.
case_id is derived from the document digest, so a redelivery lands on the same case.
Screens untrusted bytes: prompt injection, instruction content, tool poisoning, PII.
Can halt the pipeline → quarantined, terminal. Smallest surface: no policy corpus.
Denial letter → typed fields: payer, claim, service, reason, deadline. PDF or fax.
Cannot see the policy corpus. Extraction must not consult the answer key.
Finds the governing policy sections and returns them verbatim with stable ids.
No governing policy → declined_no_basis, terminal. That set is the closed world.
Each policy criterion → satisfied / not satisfied / insufficient documentation.
No appealable basis → declined_no_basis, terminal. Verdicts carry chart locators.
Writes the appeal from satisfied criteria only, citing sections by identifier.
✗ No access to the policy corpus — it may cite only what Mapping handed it.
Checks every citation three ways. Two of the three need no model at all.
✗ No write on cases — it structurally cannot edit the draft it is judging.

svg.text: Rejection findings are fed forward as the next attempt's revision instructions — telling a writer only that it failed produces the same draft again.
nothing transmits without both signatures, on the same draft attempt
Confirms the paper trail — three things a non-clinician can check:
cited sections exist · quotes match the source · nothing unsupported
Signs the clinical argument. A billing clerk is the right person to
approve paperwork and the wrong person to approve medicine. NPI on file.
BOTH REQUIRED · re-checked at transmission, not at approval
in front of every action with an effect outside this system
a crashed claim on submit_appeal is never auto-retried
create-only claim · 300 s lease · an expired claim can be taken over · a second delivery replays the stored result
quarantine_document · notify_human · record_approval · record_cosign · submit_appeal · escalate · close_case
No process. No connection. No object in memory. Weeks pass.
new deadline · status escalated · back to waiting
runs only on a schedule, never in the request path
the job's only input is stored state:

g.text: Reads cases whose payer window has elapsed and picks the next rung.
requires_human does not stop the clock; only an exhausted ladder does.

svg.text: Appeal ladder (a static table, not a model decision): first_level 30 d → peer_to_peer 14 d → second_level 30 d → external_review 45 d → close. No rung can be skipped or invented.
write = create and update · append = create only, never modified · read = read only · a blank lane means no grant at all. Every grant here is read from core/gateway.py POLICY.
